reason: I already pay for a fitness app and I follow mum-fitness creators I trust, so a program from someone I've never heard of isn't going to get my money. I might poke at the free 5 weeks, but the paid bit wouldn't even come up in the first month.
objection: 45 minutes a day just doesn't happen when her naps are 30 to 60 minutes and I'm also trying to shower and eat. And I'm not sure it's different enough from what my current app already has.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I already follow recommending it, plus shorter 15-20 minute sessions I could finish in one nap.
